column1: # IsoMathHelper: the four static transforms are the isometric projection and its inverse:
#   a(x,y,scale) = (x - y) * scale/2 -> toScreenX ; b(x,y,scale) = (x + y) * scale/2 -> toScreenY ;
#   a(sx,sy,w,h) = sx/w + sy/h -> toTileX ; b(sx,sy,w,h) = sy/h - sx/w -> toTileY.
#   (GameScreen calls them as a(x,y,128)/b(x,y,64) for screen pixels and with the tile size for
# TextFormatter: a(long) is a plain decimal string (resource totals) -> formatAmount ;
#   a(float) formats minutes:seconds with two-digit seconds -> formatTime ;
#   a(int) formats seconds.tenths from a value in thousandths -> formatTenths.
# BackgroundTask: c = progress, b = worker thread; a() reads it under the world lock -> getProgress ;
#   b() is true once run() has cleared the thread -> isDone ; a(float) is the ProgressCallback
#   implementation storing the value -> onProgress (same name as the interface method).
# WorldSerializer: a(String) lists *.world files whose name starts with the prefix and reads their
#   "name =" / "info =" header lines -> listSaves ; b(String) parses one .world file into a World
#   -> load ; the stream quartet mirrors MatchCodec: read/write carry the nullable flag and
#   readBody/writeBody are the raw payload. a(String, String[]) has no reader yet and stays unnamed.
